_comment_1: Sound Lexicon — Realtime Database security rules.
_comment_2: PASTE THIS WHOLE FILE into Firebase console > Realtime Database > Rules > Publish.
_comment_3: Also enable Build > Authentication > Sign-in method > Anonymous. Shared queues need it; nothing else on the site does.
_comment_4: Comments starting with _ are ignored by the rules engine, so this file is both the documentation and the thing you paste.

likes._note: Unchanged from before: the library's shared heart counts, world readable and writable, no auth. A number that only ever moves by one.

song_gender._note: Unchanged: the vocal-gender overlay set from the library's editor.

queues._note: Shared listening queues. A queue is public to READ by anyone holding its link — the id is the only secret, and the page says so. Writing is where the real rules live.
queues._note_index: indexOn lets a signed-in user ask for every queue they own, so a published queue stays findable after losing its link or clearing localStorage.
queues._note_read: The read here is deliberately NOT true. A plain read of this node would let anyone enumerate every queue on the site. It is granted only for the one query shape that asks for your own queues and nothing else, so listing your own is possible and listing everyone's is refused. Reading a single queue by id is allowed a level down, where the id is the secret.

meta._note: Created once by whoever makes the queue, and thereafter only that uid may touch it. owner can never be reassigned, so ownership cannot be stolen by a later write.

tracks._note: The owner may always write. Anyone signed in may write only while meta/open is true, and even then only to ADD — see $key below, which forbids a guest deleting or editing an existing row. That is what makes 'open adding' mean adding and nothing else.

$key..write: root.child('queues/' + $qid + '/meta/owner').val() === auth.uid || (auth != null && root.child('queues/' + $qid + '/meta/open').val() === true && !data.exists() && newData.child('by').val() === auth.uid)

chat._note: Open to any signed-in visitor, because chat is how a guest suggests a track when open-adding is off. A message may only be written under the author's own uid, and only the owner may delete — so nobody can edit or erase somebody else's words.

$key..write: auth != null && (!data.exists() ? newData.child('u').val() === auth.uid : root.child('queues/' + $qid + '/meta/owner').val() === auth.uid)

$rest._note: Anything not named above is closed. Without this a typo in a path would silently become a new world-writable bucket.
